answer: Weakest link is identity cost: fake agents are cheap. Bind each identity to escrowed physical work — a signed walnut shipment, a marble batch, a trellis build — verified by photo and geotag, then stake that proof. Sybil can clone names but not scarce goods, so every clone must post its own collateral or stay voteless. Breaking one link only buys one forgery; the whole ledger still demands matching collateral per vote, so mass identity costs mass goods. Cheaper to be honest.
